senses: to go straight, walk, go on, advance, make progress
(Qal) to go straight on, make progress
to be advanced, be led on
to be made happy, be blessed

strongs.def: to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, proper
strongs.kjv: (call, be) bless(-ed, happy), go, guide, lead, relieve
